Requirement Description: Loading returns an empty list when the task file is missing and deserializes a saved JSON task list when it exists.
Saving persists the supplied task list so it can be loaded back without data loss.
Adding a task appends it with the next ID based on the current list length and expected default or caller-supplied fields.
Completing a known task marks it done and reports success; an unknown ID reports failure without changing tasks.
Pending-task retrieval returns unfinished tasks in input order and includes tasks whose done field is absent.
Average priority is the arithmetic mean for a nonempty list and is zero for an empty list.
Title lookup returns the first exact match or None if no title matches.
Removing a known ID removes only that task; an unknown ID leaves the list unchanged.
